_help: Copy this to ~/.spec-harden.json and edit. spec-harden reads it automatically, so /spec-harden needs no flags. Precedence: CLI flag > env (SPEC_HARDEN_CRITIC_MODEL / _EFFORT / _DEPTH) > this file > built-in default. critic_model: any Codex model your ChatGPT account supports (gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.5). critic_effort: low | medium | high | xhigh. depth: spec (spec-quality only) | design (also challenge the approach, tradeoffs, and alternatives). critic_timeout: seconds per critic round (default 900). context: "repo" (default: git toplevel of the spec, so the critic can verify file/line claims) | "none" | ["/extra/dir", ...]. final_verify: off | sonnet | opus | haiku | fable | gemini (opt-in extra cross-check after the Codex loop converges).
